prompt.zh-TW: 下列哪些事情會讓海風衝浪店的未分配盈餘變多？
prompt.en: Which of the following would increase Seabreeze Surf’s unappropriated retained earnings?

text.zh-TW: 這一期賣衝浪板賺到的利益
text.en: The profit earned this period from selling boards

feedback.zh-TW: 會。本期淨利會流進未分配盈餘。
feedback.en: Yes. Profit for the period flows into unappropriated retained earnings.

text.zh-TW: 把店後方的空間租給鄰居，這一期的租金收入
text.en: Rental income this period from letting the space behind the shop to a neighbour

feedback.zh-TW: 會。租金不是本業的收入，放在{{term:tm_6nmfxa10}}，但一樣會讓本期淨利變多，最後流進未分配盈餘。
feedback.en: Yes. Rent is not revenue from the core business, so it goes under {{term:tm_6nmfxa10}}, but it still raises profit for the period, which flows into unappropriated retained earnings all the same.

text.zh-TW: 這一期一位新股東投入的資金
text.en: Money put in by a new shareholder this period

feedback.zh-TW: 新股東的錢確實讓股東權益變多，這點沒錯。不過它記在股本（高於面額發行時，超過面額的部分記在資本公積），不是未分配盈餘；只有賺來的錢才會進未分配盈餘。
feedback.en: A new shareholder’s money does increase equity, that much is right. But it is recorded as share capital (any premium above par goes to capital surplus), not unappropriated retained earnings; only earnings go into unappropriated retained earnings.

text.zh-TW: 收回去年賒銷給衝浪營隊的貨款
text.en: Collecting what a surf camp still owed from last year’s credit sale

feedback.zh-TW: 收到錢確實讓現金變多，這點沒錯。不過這筆生意的利益去年就算過了，今年收款只是應收帳款換成現金，未分配盈餘不會再增加。
feedback.en: Collecting the money does increase cash, that much is right. But the profit on that sale was counted last year; collecting it this year merely turns a receivable into cash, and unappropriated retained earnings do not rise again.

explanation.zh-TW: 只有「賺到的錢」會進{{term:tm_4c6v99nn}}。{{option:o_bnc4}}與{{option:o_rjd7}}都讓本期淨利增加，所以都會；{{option:o_9ppe}}是股東投入的本錢，記在{{term:tm_5e3py55a}}；{{option:o_vpk8}}只是資產之間的交換。
explanation.en: Only earnings go into {{term:tm_4c6v99nn}}. {{option:o_bnc4}} and {{option:o_rjd7}} both raise profit for the period, so both count; {{option:o_9ppe}} is a stake put up by a shareholder and goes to {{term:tm_5e3py55a}}; {{option:o_vpk8}} is merely a swap between two assets.
